decisions.reason: This product duplicates Product F but was only mentioned on the website, so the firm's absorptive capacity allows it to recognize redundancy and reallocate resources to the more established glazed door.
It builds directly on the firm's thermal-insulation and sectional-door expertise, enabling the firm to assimilate early feedback and improve the product.
As the featured glazed industrial sectional door with its own page, it aligns with existing capabilities and the firm can learn from market results to continue development.
